nom: ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizing Cleansing Foam

segments.sensitive: One reviewer describes the cleanser as very gentle even for sensitive skin, while another reports that it makes her skin feel a little more sensitive.

concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report their skin feels hydrated and not stripped or dry after use, including one who normally avoids foaming cleansers for this reason; no reviewer reports dryness from this product.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as non-stripping and gentle, with skin feeling clean rather than tight or compromised.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports it hasn't caused breakouts, with no dissenting reports of new blemishes.

extraits.texte: This is my new Holy Grail cleanser! You need only a tiny pea size dot and it lathers into a nice, rich foam. The main ingredient, glycerin gives it a nice slip that helps remove stubborn eye makeup, but without it being so soapy that it gets in your eyes. Its very gently, even for sensitive skin. I love this! Ive tried so many clenasers over rhe years, and this is by far my favorite.

I absolutely love this foaming face wash that contains PDRN. It works great with the Anua oil cleanser. Double cleansing has worked wonders on my skin & so has this product! Leaves my skin feeling hydrated and not stripped. All my makeup is washed away and I don't see any trace of makeup on my toner pad. Leaves my skin so clean and moisturized. Highly recommend if you're looking for a cleanser with PDRN & to use in conjunction with an oil cleanser. I also use the Anua PDRN toner, PDRN serum, & PDRN Moisturizing Gel twice a day (AM/PM) All are spectacular & layer well!!!
Love this facewash, i feel like my skin has thrived while using it. It doesnt strip my skin, and has a nice foaming lather to it which i love.
I use this with the deep cleansing foam and it's perfect. It doesn't leave me face dry, I use it morning and night . I use Tretnoin. Plus the smells is nice and soft. A little bit goes a long way.
I usually stay clear from foaming cleansers since they leave my skin feeling stripped and dry. This though, does not! :) My skin feels clean and hydrated! Hasn't caused me to break out either.
I love the thick abs velvety texture of this product. My skin is noticeably more glowing. The only drawback is that it makes my skin feel a little more sensitive.

reserve: Only 7 reviews are available and none are critical (all 5/5), so conclusions on dissent or negative outcomes are limited.
